NEW: No learned NEW head; shared native births after private NEW dummy choice. All enhanced methods use exactly the same row confidence anchor: preference - max_legal(preference) + max_legal(raw_GMT_score - original_native_candidate_threshold); NEW value = 0. All-masked rows choose NEW. Existing preference may differ; capacity interactions can still change births. Lifecycle OFF.
TopK: Full candidate support in all main experiments; report TRAIN Recall@8/16/32/64/Full before training. No heldout-dependent truncation.
calibration_metric: same validation original-group-weighted conditional known-candidate NLL; report Brier/ECE and unknown selections separately

deployment_preference.joint: sum of the two heads, common temperature calibration

epoch_budget.trigger: if ANY of the three main correctness-supervised models has group-weighted TRAIN candidate rank1 < 0.95 at the common budget, ALL architecture/supervision/seed runs receive the next common budget; never based on validation, heldout or JEV relative ranking

group_weights: Preserve frozen conflict-group identity and sampling provenance; each original group contributes equal training mass; rows within group share that mass. Overlap dependency bundles are diagnostic inference units, not new groups or new samples.
normalization: TRAIN-only original conflict-group-weighted state/evidence mean and std; candidates receive within-row equal weights; std < 1e-8 constant features map to zero; persisted model buffers used identically at training and production

ordinary_controls.QA_context_ablations: use JEV-selected supervision for primary structure comparison; correctness-only JEV already supplies the no-causal comparison
ordinary_controls.common_assignment: assign_candidate_values, values mode, identical confidence anchor and private NEW dummy
ordinary_controls.dynamic: raw score minus native threshold minus alpha * gallery_available * (1-gallery_cosine)/(1+sqrt(window_observations)); alpha grid [0, .05, .1, .2]
ordinary_controls.fixed: raw score minus native candidate threshold
ordinary_controls.learned_selection: Within each architecture choose supervision by mean validation selection NLL over three seeds; retain all three seeds for closed-loop comparison
ordinary_controls.rule_selection: Validation pooled HOTA for dynamic alpha; ties choose smallest alpha; select before heldout

selection_metric: group-weighted candidate correctness NLL of deployment preference for every architecture/supervision/seed; rank-only uses its active utility preference rather than an untrained unused correctness head

supervisions.H32_ranking: pairwise softplus utility preference ordering, only executed uncensored existing candidate choices; unknown/unexecuted not labeled; exact ties excluded
supervisions.correctness: multi-positive conditional correctness CE, denominator only confirmed known candidates; unknown candidates are not negative labels
supervisions.joint: correctness CE plus utility ranking, task weights 1:1

tiny.extension_requires: inspect finite/mask/normalization and exact feature-label collisions first; same budget for all three models
tiny.selection: chronological first two original TRAIN conflict groups per video, at most three known-positive supervised rows per group; no validation or utility-based selection

uncertainty: Report all three videos and three seeds; paired differences and 2000 bootstrap replicates over videos and independent overlap bundles with seed 20261008. Three heldout videos limit architecture significance claims. Never treat overlapping H32 windows as independent.
unified_claim: MATCH-only WHO constant and fixed lifecycle cannot establish query transfer or unified MATCH/MEMORY/REACTIVATION superiority
